title: Handle missing values in DataFrame cleaning helper
body: The clean_columns function drops rows with NaN instead of filling them. Add an option to fill with the column median using pandas.

title: Docs: example for reading CSV files with encoding errors
body: Add a short docs section showing how to read CSV files that fail with UnicodeDecodeError using pandas and the encoding argument.

title: Add type hints to CLI argument parser
body: Functions in cli.py have no type hints. Add annotations and make sure mypy passes.

title: Flask route returns 500 on empty JSON body
body: POST /api/items crashes when the request body is empty. Return a 400 response with a clear error message instead.

title: Speed up tokenizer for long text
body: The tokenizer loops in pure Python. Use a compiled regex and add a small benchmark script.

title: Add unit tests for date parsing
body: Date parsing has no tests. Add pytest cases for ISO and US date formats.

title: Plot labels overlap in matplotlib bar chart
body: When there are more than ten categories the x axis labels overlap. Rotate labels and wrap long names.

title: Support reading Parquet files in the data loader
body: Add a loader for parquet files using pandas and pyarrow, with a test and a docs note.

title: Remove duplicate rows when merging two datasets
body: merge_tables keeps duplicate rows after joining. Add a drop_duplicates step and a data cleaning test.

title: Button hover state missing in dark theme
body: The primary button has no hover style when the dark theme is on. Add CSS for the hover and focus states.

title: Add input validation to signup form
body: The signup form accepts empty emails. Validate the field in the browser and show an inline error.

title: Express middleware logs request body twice
body: The logging middleware prints each request body two times. Remove the duplicate and add a test.

title: Convert callbacks to async await in file helper
body: readConfig still uses callbacks. Rewrite it with async await and keep the public API the same.

title: Dropdown closes when clicking its scrollbar
body: In the select component, clicking the scrollbar closes the menu. Fix the blur handling.

title: README missing npm install instructions
body: Add install and usage steps for the CLI to the README.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts to the todo app
body: Support Enter to add a todo and Escape to cancel editing. Update the help dialog.

title: Fix typo in error message for missing token
body: The auth error says 'tokne'. Correct the spelling and update the snapshot test.

title: Improve chart tooltip formatting
body: Tooltips show raw numbers. Format them with thousands separators.

title: React component re-renders on every keystroke
body: SearchBox re-renders its parent list on each keystroke. Memoize the list with useMemo and add a React test.

title: Add TypeScript types for the API client responses
body: Responses from the API client are typed as any. Add interfaces for the user and project endpoints.

title: Frontend: sidebar overlaps content on narrow screens
body: Below 700px the sidebar covers the main content. Make the layout responsive with a collapsible menu.

title: Fix strict null errors in utils folder
body: Enabling strictNullChecks produces 12 errors in utils. Fix them without changing behavior.

title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
body: Add a toggle in the React settings page that stores the choice in localStorage.

title: Write tests for useDebounce hook
body: The useDebounce hook has no tests. Add tests with React Testing Library and fake timers.

title: Docs: add usage example for form component
body: Add a copy-paste example for the Form component to the Storybook docs.

title: Table sorting breaks with undefined values
body: Sorting a column that has undefined values throws. Treat undefined as the smallest value.

title: Export CSV button downloads empty file
body: The export button in the dashboard produces an empty CSV when filters are active.

title: Spring Boot endpoint returns 200 for invalid input
body: POST /orders returns 200 when the quantity is negative. Return 400 with a validation message.

title: Add pagination to the REST API for products
body: GET /products returns every row. Add page and size parameters and update the API docs.

title: Replace System.out with a logger in backend jobs
body: Several batch jobs print with System.out. Use SLF4J logging instead.

title: Write unit tests for PriceCalculator
body: PriceCalculator has no tests. Add JUnit tests for discounts and tax.

title: Null pointer when user has no address
body: The profile API throws a NullPointerException for users without an address. Return an empty address object.

title: Document the authentication API in OpenAPI
body: Add OpenAPI annotations to the login and refresh token endpoints.

title: Upgrade Jackson to the latest patch version
body: Bump Jackson and run the backend test suite. Fix any deprecations.

title: Add health check endpoint
body: Expose /health returning the database status for the backend service.

title: Improve error message when config file is missing
body: The loader throws a generic exception. Include the expected path in the message.

title: CLI panics when no arguments are given
body: Running the tool with no arguments panics. Print the usage text and exit with code 2.

title: Add context timeout to HTTP client
body: The HTTP client has no timeout. Use context with a default of 10 seconds and make it configurable.

title: Race condition in cache cleanup goroutine
body: go test -race reports a data race in the cache cleanup loop. Protect the map with a mutex.

title: Add table-driven tests for URL parser
body: Add table-driven tests that cover relative and absolute URLs.

title: Docs: godoc comments for exported functions
body: Exported functions in the config package lack godoc comments. Add them.

title: Support JSON output flag in list command
body: Add a --json flag to the list command that prints machine-readable output.

title: Reduce allocations in log formatter
body: The formatter builds strings with fmt.Sprintf in a hot loop. Use a strings.Builder and add a benchmark.

title: Return wrapped errors from storage layer
body: Use fmt.Errorf with %w so callers can use errors.Is.

title: Add graceful shutdown to the API server
body: The server stops abruptly on SIGTERM. Use http.Server Shutdown with a timeout.
